svg.title: Agello engineering by the numbers
svg.desc: 64K exact token context; 0 host read copies; 0% GPU load during RAG on the 16-Core ANE; 4.5x faster Vision encode; +5 MB across a 200-turn soak; 622 automated tests (493 unit, 90 device, 39 UI) across real iPhone 17 Pro hardware gates and AgelloSim.
